name: MutualAidCrewOnboarding
tagline: Check in, brief, lodge, assign and release storm mutual aid crews in one Power Apps control.
description: Complete mutual aid crew module for electric, gas and water utilities: crew requests and ETAs, staging check-in, safety briefings with validity, document and radio checks, hotel room blocks with capacity, local guides, assignments with the work-rest rule, release, radio return and demobilisation, daily cost tracking and a crew-lead self check-in page for Power Pages.
features: Nine-stage crew lifecycle with business rules
Onboarding checklist matrix and group briefing sessions
Hotel room blocks with capacity-checked booking
Work-rest shift clock and rest-due alerts
Daily run rate and cost to date
Bulk actions, CSV export and undo
Demo mode with fictional storm data
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: MutualAidCrewOnboarding data-set + MutualAidCrewOnboardingPortal field control)
